fields.mechanism: smart battery management systems that enhance resilience while maintaining energy density
fields.intervention: Implementing an advanced battery management system (BMS) with machine learning-driven fault detection at the pack level for consumer products
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of thermal runaway conditions, dendrite formation, and potential short circuits before they lead to thermal events, with automatic shutdown or protective response
fields.falsification_test: Subject batteries with and without the BMS to overcharge, mechanical damage, and use with cheap chargers while monitoring temperature, voltage, and internal resistance for failure points
fields.mechanism_source_span: smart battery management systems that enhance resilience while maintaining energy density

fields.intervention: integration of nanostructured thermal barriers between battery cells within consumer product battery packs
fields.expected_effect: containment of thermal runaway propagation within individual cells, preventing cascading failure that leads to battery fires
fields.falsification_test: measure temperature distribution across battery cells during induced thermal runaway events to verify barrier effectiveness

fields.falsification_test: subject retrofitted battery packs to overcharging, mechanical damage, and use with cheap chargers while monitoring temperature, voltage, and current; compare with unprotected batteries to verify prevention of thermal runaway
